name: Tsunuga Shougo
source:
A tall, reserved young man, Tsunuga is an expert in close-quarters combat, boasting proficiency in martial arts and a range of small firearms. His physique is a testament to his rigorous training, featuring solid, honed muscles. He collaborates with a Witch named Carol in a personal crusade to dismantle the organization that holds sway over Pandemonium.

[Edited from [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1144#characters]MangaGamer[/url]]

[spoiler]Tsunuga is the only survivor from the team that stormed a criminal organization implicated in a series of kidnapping cases. The case was known as 'SAT's blundered raid of the century' within the police force. [/spoiler]
